content:
alex: Heads up — multiple orgs reporting dashboard panels stuck on spinner then 500s. Console shows analytics-api 500 responses. example x-request-id: a1b2c3f4
monitoring-bot: ALERT analytics-api: increased 5xx rate (6x) in last 5m — firing on threshold rule `analytics.5xx_rate` :rotating_light:
maria: Customer ACME hit this. Their graphs turn empty then show error, reported 07:12 UTC. I grabbed their repro query and workspace id.
alex: Repro curl I ran from prod cluster:```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/analytics/query 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"query":"SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE ts >= now() - interval 1 hour GROUP BY path"}'```
sam: Looking at analytics-api logs — getting `timeout waiting for connection to ClickHouse` and a bunch of `500 internal server error` traces. Connection pool saturated on workers-2.
jess: I see queue depth + latency spike on analytics-workers-2 around 07:10. Recent deploy `analytics-api@v1.3.4` rolled ~07:00. Can we rollback? :thinking_face: 
deploy-bot: action=rollback service=analytics-api from=v1.3.4 to=v1.2.9 by=jess — started
maria: Pushed a quick note to ACME: will update when rollback completes. They said graphs briefly recovered then failed again for a few panels.
alex: Captured a sample trace id th:9f8e7d — full trace shows long planner phase then connection pool exhaustion. Attaching stack snippet below:```panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 452 [running]:
main.(*QueryPlanner).Plan(0xc000...)

```
sam: Root cause appears to be a planner regression in v1.3.4 that creates very long-running SELECTs for time-windowed queries, which exhausts the ClickHouse connections and yields 500s. Patch ready to bypass the new planner for queries with `time_bucket` until we ship proper fix.
jess: Can we hotfix prod asap? ~12 orgs impacted. Recommend scheduled rollback/hotfix and a short status page update.
alex: Filed incident INC-2026-3477 and updated status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-3477 — pinged account execs for the affected customers.
support-bot: Noted. I'll follow up with customer-facing messages and include repro steps + ETA. :thumbsup:
alex: Next steps: hotfix roll + increase clickhouse connection pool temporarily, add alert to catch planner latency regressions. I'll handoff to eng-oncall to run the hotfix and confirm recovery.
